# Onboarding

## Requirements

- **FR-001**: The wizard MUST reject an invalid email address with an inline error.
- **NFR-001**: Every wizard page MUST meet WCAG 2.2 AA.

## Success Criteria

- **SC-001**: Users are happier with onboarding.
- **SC-002**: 90% of new users finish onboarding on the first attempt.
- **SC-003**: No user sees a blank page during onboarding.
